content: Cat: Walked away - sellers re-traded agreed terms, ~600 K€ additional liabilities and the real estate carve-out reversed

• Commercial goalposts moved repeatedly after the terms were agreed on 30 Jun — most recently earn-out base, guarantee release costs and refinancing: no stable basis to sign
  • ~600 K€ of additional liabilities against the agreed price basis; sellers now want to keep the real estate in the company, reversing the agreed carve-out
  • Deal to be put on-hold until somewhen next year

• Phase 1 (CDD/FDD) concluding on both projects - no red flags, findings limited to the known yellow flags
  • SPA and seller documents drafting kicks off in the week of 03 Aug, running in parallel to TDD/LDD
  • Signing unchanged at 03/04 Sep
Mantis: Exclusive German partnership with the Chinese manufacturer in reach: upside on top of the LOI case

• Exclusive distribution partnership for Germany to be concluded — not reflected in the LOI case, and the reason the senior owner extends his stay with the company
  • Requires 250 K€ CAPEX into the manufacturer's product; the product retains market value
  • To verify in DD: contract terms including the change-of-control clause (gate before signing) and the volume case behind the investment
Strada x Repuro: Ratchet and Equity Deployment in preparation

• Based on yesterday's discussion preparation and update of equity deployment and ratchet proposal
  • Cost to be provided as well next week
  • Timeline unchanged: IC on 24/25 Aug, closing in the week before Fox and Mantis signing on 03/04 Sep
